notes.title: Tech Update!
notes.content:
Along with thoughts on the Main Street level variations (THANK YOU!) I have also gotten a few emails about random tech problems people have run into.  I tried to roll all of them into this latest update, so if any of these help issues you've had, then AWWW YEAH!  And if not, just let me know what is buggin' ya!

1. WONKY FRAME RATE
One player was trying to get WB up and running on their TV, but the framerate just BOMBED.  After a few hours of trial and error, we finally found the culprit- the TV had an odd synchronization rate that was throwing it off.  The settings screen now has a toggle that lets you disable vsync.  If your frame rate is just plain BAD, try that first, and let me know!

2. TERRIBLE FIRST-TIME UI NAVIGATION 
When WB first shipped I was doing a lot of playtesting on a single keyboard with two users.  It was fun, but it means I had to use WASD for one player and the arrows for the second.  (It works! You can still go into configurations and set that up, if you so desire!)  BUT defaulting the arrows to player 2 made the game WAY CONFUSING for first time users going through the menu.   Now, we default to arrows on player 1 along with WASD.  If you want to reset your controls entirely for this, that can also be done in the settings page.

3. NOT-SO-DARK VERSION 2
Last patch included a sample of the new idea for making the game less dark, and this patch goes nuts with that concept.  Basically, if outside levels like the town or campsite were crazy dark before, now you should be able to see those stars!

4. NETWORK OPTIMIZATION
Online is still sittin' purty in Beta mode, but I've kept making tweaks to it to make sure it runs as smoothly as possible.  This last round tweaks the packet rate, which means the systems update each other a bit faster and you are less likely to see skating.

notes.title: Welcome FRED!
notes.content:
Frankenbaby has finally pulled themselves together and has joined the critters!  They do get a bit grabby, however, so don't be surprised if they steal the sitter's powerup right in the middle of an intense battle!

Also, someone brought up that the game looked a bit dark on their screen and some backgrounds were getting lost in the murky depths of night.  We at Well Bred Rhino FULLY support night lights, so we've added a new dynamic system that shades the background based on the setting's darkness config.  If anything still looks hard to see, just let me know!

AND FINALLY, the next battleground being developed is a huge street that will let babies and sitters alike bounce between the different levels of the map.  I've got two designs I've mocked up, and I'm starting to play test them with friends and enemies to see which layout works better.  But since we are Early Access.... WHY NOT SHARE WITH YOU ALL, TOO!  The Street Map is in!  There are two versions - Wide and Tall.  Let me know which one you prefer and why!

notes.title: Not "A" Mall, THE Mall!
notes.content:
[i]The Grand Opening for the Talbot Commons Shopping Mall is upon us!  

Dine at one of our many eateries!  Enjoy the FINEST of fashions at BroBoutique! Stop by our arcade for flashing lights!  Talbot Commons, where our motto is "You Break It You Buy It!"[/i]


The mall level is ready to be shared, and I hope you enjoy it!  It was a fun adventure trying to give all the shops their own unique identify and clutter, and it ended up WAY bigger than I first intended.  That said, I want to make sure EVERY level has its own vibe, so it SORT of worked out according to plan?  Sure.  Why not.  

Give it a try, let me know what you think, and have fun breaking stuff!  This is also our first big update, so if anything goes wonkily, just let me know!
